acceptance: The fixture runner drives SPA, multi-page, reload, document replacement and iframe transitions: SPA keeps one epoch, page loads and replacements start larger epochs, frame navigation changes only the frame generation, and the replica equals the page after every step across three identical runs.

positive.fixture: 5 browser tests, three runs with identical normalised traces

negative.fixture: cleared storage and a different origin still produce larger or independent epochs; epochs never fall below the clock

security_and_source_permissions: The observer reads structure and declared labels only; form values are never read, credential regions yield no text, account text is flagged and withheld from shared evidence, and no network surface exists.
performance_memory_storage: Epoch allocation is one storage read and write per baseline.
known_limitations: Back-forward cache restores are not distinguished from reloads
